comment: DOC-GIF 配置开关效果清单（唯一事实源）。capture=true 的开关由 generate.py 驱动真实服务出 off/on 终端证据 + 循环 GIF，兼作配置效果回归测试（行为断言不过即红）；capture=false 的开关无单服务可截图面（全栈联动/时间维度/部署面），进文档页文末手工验证清单，不配图不编造。

switches.name: 敏感词表
switches.effect: 发帖/评论/拆解文本命中词表即 400 拒绝；表空回落内置默认词表。演示：含「违禁演示词」的帖子 off=200 发布成功 / on=400 被拒。
switches.effect_en: Posts/comments/guide text containing a listed word is rejected with 400; an empty list falls back to the built-in defaults. Demo post: off=200 accepted, on=400 rejected.

switches.name: 审核管理员名单
switches.effect: 名单内用户可置顶帖/处置举报/精选拆解；名单外 403。演示：用户 7 置顶帖子 off=403 / on=200。
switches.effect_en: Users on the allowlist can pin posts, handle reports and feature breakdowns; others get 403. Demo: user 7 pins a post, off=403 / on=200.

switches.name: 内部通知令牌（GP-306）
switches.effect: POST /internal/notifications 按令牌严格比对；未配置恒 403（fail-closed）。演示：带正确令牌调用 off=403 / on=200 created=1。
switches.effect_en: POST /internal/notifications compares X-Internal-Token strictly; unconfigured always 403 (fail-closed). Demo with the right token: off=403 / on=200 created=1.

switches.name: 经营分析摄入口令（GP-402）
switches.effect: POST /internal/events 事实事件摄入按令牌严格比对；空令牌整体拒绝。演示：摄入一条事件 off=403 / on=200 accepted=1。
switches.effect_en: POST /internal/events compares X-Internal-Token strictly; an empty token rejects everything. Demo ingesting one event: off=403 / on=200 accepted=1.

switches.name: 分析查询名单
switches.effect: 漏斗/留存/活动效果等分析查询端点仅名单内用户可读，名单为空全关。演示：用户 7 查询 overview off=403 / on=200。
switches.effect_en: Analytics query endpoints (funnel/retention/campaign) are readable only by allowlisted users; an empty list closes all. Demo: user 7 queries overview, off=403 / on=200.

switches.name: 目录内部端点令牌
switches.effect: GET /internal/games/:id/reservation-users（活动通知受众）按令牌严格比对；空令牌恒 403。演示：查询游戏 1 预约人群 off=403 / on=200。
switches.effect_en: GET /internal/games/:id/reservation-users (campaign notification audience) compares the token strictly; empty token always 403. Demo querying game 1: off=403 / on=200.

switches.name: 实时投递令牌
switches.effect: POST /internal/publish 服务间投递按令牌严格比对；未配置恒 403。演示：投递一帧 off=403 / on=200 delivered=0。
switches.effect_en: POST /internal/publish compares the token strictly; unconfigured always 403. Demo publishing a frame: off=403 / on=200 delivered=0.

switches.name: 离线推送 webhook
switches.effect: 目标用户零投递（不在线）时回调该地址转厂商推送；空 = 不推。演示：向离线用户 42 投递，接收器 off=无回调 / on=收到 POST。
switches.effect_en: When a target user has zero live deliveries (offline), the hub calls this URL for vendor push bridging; empty = no call. Demo publishing to offline user 42: receiver off=no callback / on=POST received.

switches.name: 上游服务地址
switches.effect: 反代路由按上游地址转发；上游不可达时网关回 502。效果面在部署面（需同时跑上下游），列手工验证。
switches.effect_en: Proxy routes forward to the configured upstreams; unreachable upstream yields 502. Observable only with a running stack, so manual verification.

switches.name: 实时推送联动
switches.effect: 配置后站内通知经 realtime-hub /internal/publish 实时下发；空 = 不推（通知仅落库）。观察面在客户端 WS 流，列手工验证。
switches.effect_en: When set, notifications are also pushed live via realtime-hub /internal/publish; empty = DB only. Observable on the client WS stream, so manual verification.

switches.name: Redis 跨实例投递
switches.effect: 配置后启用 Redis pub/sub 跨实例帧投递（尽力而为）；空 = 单实例内存模式。效果面需 Redis 与多实例部署，列手工验证。
switches.effect_en: When set, frames relay across instances via Redis pub/sub (best effort); empty = single-instance in-memory. Requires Redis and a multi-instance deployment, so manual verification.

switches.name: 审核回执通知
switches.effect: 提审状态流转时回调 community 内部通知端点；未配置 = no-op。联动需 community 同跑，列手工验证。
switches.effect_en: Game review status changes call back the community internal notification endpoint; unconfigured = no-op. Requires community running, so manual verification.

switches.name: 目录事件上报
switches.effect: 目录侧事实事件 fire-and-forget 上报 data-panel /internal/events；BaseURL 未配置 = no-op。联动需 data-panel 同跑，列手工验证。
switches.effect_en: Catalog facts are forwarded fire-and-forget to data-panel /internal/events; BaseURL unset = no-op. Requires data-panel running, so manual verification.

switches.name: 优惠券锁定超时释放
switches.effect: 锁定超时的优惠券被后台扫描释放回可领池；TTL 内保持锁定。效果沿时间轴展开且需 payments+adapter 全链路，列手工验证。
switches.effect_en: Coupons locked past the TTL are swept back to the claimable pool; within TTL they stay locked. Unfolds over time and needs the payments+adapter stack, so manual verification.

switches.name: 令牌有效期（天）
switches.effect: 登录签发 JWT 的过期时限；效果沿时间轴展开（过期后 401），无即时前后帧差，列手工验证。
switches.effect_en: Expiry horizon of JWTs issued at login; the effect unfolds over time (401 after expiry), so no immediate off/on frame difference — manual verification.
